name: open-node
description: Open-source framework for embeddable node interfaces and executable graphs

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:workspaces
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @open-node/model && npm run build -w @open-node/type-system && npm run build -w @open-node/commands && npm run build -w @open-node/scheduler && npm run build -w @open-node/sdk && npm run build -w @open-node/timeline && npm run build -w @open-node/assets && npm run build -w @open-node/telemetry && npm run build -w @open-node/core-nodes && npm run build -w @open-node/io && npm run build -w @open-node/engine && npm run build -w @open-node/machine-api && npm run build -w @open-node/mcp-adapter && npm run build -w @open-node/ui && npm run build -w @open-node/embed
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run build:packages && npm run build:app
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:workspaces
